title: OpenLand
tagline: Land maker to which anyone can freely add objects and logic.
description:
The core concept is to create a foundation for the construction of a metaverse that is not centrally controlled by anyone. 

And when I thought about Infinite Game, which is strongly connected to the Autonomous World concept, I wanted to connect it with something that would keep people engaged throughout their lives, not something they would get bored with. That is art and society.

I wanted to create a land where people could place purchased NFT art, and I wanted to create a platform that would make it easy for people to create games that they could play together.
how_its_made:
The Client side uses React and Three.js.
And on the blockchain side, I'm using the MUD framework. Currently it is possible to issue ERC-721 NFTs through World's System. The metadata refers to the MUD Store.

Although currently not implemented, it would allow for transactions on a per-land basis by placing objects, storing them in the MUD store, and having the owner of the ERC721 have those permissions.

I would like to see the bottom-up metaverse expand. But for that to happen, localized centralization is necessary. For this reason, we designed the system to use OpenLand and to allow businesses to build on OpenLand. For this purpose, a MUD framework that is easy to extend and easy to interconnect is useful.
